page.overview:
Who is Combat Ship 2?

Combat Ship 2 is a minor character in Cars 2. He and Combat Ship are heavily armed combat ships working for Professor Z.

In the beginning of the film, he is suspended along with Combat Ship to the main oil platform. When Finn McMissile escapes in his hydrofoil mode, the combat ship launches missiles and Acer mounts in a machine gun platform on the combat ship. Combat Ship launches a torpedo, and Finn explodes. However, Finn actually faked his own death and escapes. Later in the film, he is in Tokyo in the abandoned barracks, where the lemons killed Rod "Torque" Redline. The ship is not seen afterwards.
